fact: The Direction Générale des Impôts reports that the NINACAD-ADRESSE digital addressing application, at its design phase, covers about 1,500,000 places or parcels in the ten communes of Bamako District, parts of Kati cercle and the towns of Ségou, Koulikoro, Markala and Sikasso.

L'Essor reports the permanent secretary for land reform saying Ninacad-Adresse, a six-digit code per plot with a secure database, covers about 1,500,000 plots in Bamako, parts of Kati and Segou, with deployment in Koulikoro and Sikasso under way.
